title: Fundamentals, Topology & Bandwidth
desc: Why PCIe exists, lanes and links, the RC/switch/endpoint tree, generations, encoding, and bandwidth math you can do on a whiteboard.

title: Layered Architecture
desc: Transaction, Data Link and Physical layers, what each owns, end-to-end versus per-hop fields, and where each kind of error is detected.

title: Physical Layer & Electricals
desc: Differential signaling, embedded clocks, scrambling, electrical idle, reference clocking, jitter, eye diagrams, PAM4 and lane margining.

title: LTSSM & Link Training
desc: Every LTSSM state and sub-state, TS1/TS2 contents, Recovery, speed and width changes, timeouts, and how to triage link-up failures.

title: Equalization & Retimers
desc: Why equalization exists, presets and coefficients, the four Gen3+ phases, status bits for debug, retimers versus redrivers.

title: Data Link Layer
desc: Sequence numbers, LCRC, ACK/NAK, replay buffer and timers, DLLP formats, DL states and reading correctable-error counters.

title: TLP Anatomy & Transaction Types
desc: Header fields, formats and types, addressing and routing, MPS/MRRS/RCB, completions and status, prefixes, atomics.

title: Flow Control & Ordering
desc: Credits, InitFC/UpdateFC, virtual channels, the ordering table, relaxed and ID-based ordering, deadlock avoidance.

title: Config Space & Enumeration
desc: Type 0/1 headers, BAR sizing, capability lists, ECAM, the enumeration algorithm and bus numbering.

title: Interrupts (INTx / MSI / MSI-X)
desc: Legacy INTx emulation, MSI and MSI-X structures, vector tables, PBA, masking and affinity.

title: Power Management
desc: D-states, L-states, ASPM, L1 substates, LTR, PME, and how NVMe power states interact with the link.

title: Errors, AER & DPC
desc: Error classes, AER registers and header logs, completion timeouts, poisoned TLPs, containment and recovery.

title: Virtualization & I/O Services
desc: SR-IOV, ATS/PRI/PASID, ACS, IOMMU interaction, peer-to-peer, TPH and AtomicOps.

title: Gen5/6, FLIT, CXL & Security
desc: Precoding, PAM4, FLIT mode and FEC, L0p, CXL on the PCIe PHY, IDE and DOE/SPDM.

title: Resets, Hot-Plug & Form Factors
desc: PERST#, hot reset, FLR, surprise removal, sideband signals, M.2, U.2/U.3, E1.S/E3.S, OCuLink.

title: NVMe over PCIe (Cross-layer)
desc: BAR0 registers, doorbells, queues and PRP/SGL as TLPs, MSI-X per queue, CC.EN resets, CMB/PMR and P2P.

title: Debug, Analyzers & Compliance
desc: Reading protocol-analyzer traces, link-up triage, lspci/setpci and Windows tooling, compliance, loopback, stress and error injection.

title: Scenarios & System Design
desc: Open-ended validation-plan and root-cause questions that cross every layer, the way a Principal loop tests them.
